<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope (significant M+1 ~11 % and progressively smaller M+2, M+3, etc.) the pattern matches the natural ¹³C distribution expected for a molecule containing multiple carbons. No strong M+2 peak characteristic of Cl, Br, or S is present, so those elements cannot be confirmed. Thus the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope pattern is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
